text.name: NF_active_long
text.text: Switches the neighbours' traffic on or off. Off = no new vehicles, vehicles on the road finish their trip.

text.name: NF_trafficLimit_long
text.text: How many AI traffic vehicles drive simultaneously on the map? (1-8). Waypoints and spawn points are set in the 'Waypoints' tab.

text.name: NF_trafficTrailerSize_long
text.text: Implements for traffic vehicles. 0 = None | 1 = Small | 2 = Medium | 3 = All (plows, cultivators, mowers, tedders, rakes, seed drills)

text.name: NF_engeMap_long
text.text: For narrow maps and cramped dealer areas: neighbours only use small and medium tractors (up to 12 t) with light implements (tedders, rakes, up to 3 t). Large tractors, wheel loaders and telehandlers stay out. Off = everything allowed.

text.name: input_NF_DELETE_HELPER
text.text: Living Roads: Remove all neighbour vehicles

text.name: input_NF_MANAGE_WAYPOINTS
text.text: Living Roads: Show waypoints one by one

text.name: NF_wpMapShow_long
text.text: Show waypoints as markers on the ingame map (category: MISCELLANEOUS)

text.name: NF_wpType_long
text.text: Cycle category: Normal (20-60s) | Short (5-20s) | Long (2-5 min) | Spawn point. Better create new spawn points with 'Set spawn point here' - older points have no reliable direction.

text.name: NF_wpAddHere_long
text.text: Places a normal waypoint at your position (in a vehicle: at the vehicle's position). Keep at least 10 m from other points.

text.name: NF_wpAddSpawnHere_long
text.text: New neighbour vehicles start here. Sit in a tractor facing the exit direction (on foot your view direction counts). About 4 m width must be clear from 3 m in front to 14 m behind the point. Drive away afterwards - while your vehicle stands there, the point counts as occupied.

text.name: NF_wpNone
text.text: No waypoints - use 'Set waypoint here' or 'Set spawn point here' below

text.name: NF_wpCatTractorS_long
text.text: Spawn small tractors (up to ~100 HP) as traffic vehicles

text.name: NF_wpCatTractorM_long
text.text: Spawn medium tractors (~100-200 HP) as traffic vehicles

text.name: NF_wpCatTractorL_long
text.text: Spawn large tractors (200+ HP) as traffic vehicles

text.name: NF_wpCatLoader_long
text.text: Spawn wheel loaders as traffic vehicles (only if navmesh-capable)

text.name: NF_wpCatTeleLoader_long
text.text: Spawn telescopic handlers as traffic vehicles (only if navmesh-capable)

text.name: NF_hinweisSpawnpunkt
text.text: An automatic loading spot failed. More reliable: set a spawn point (ESC > Settings > Waypoints > Set spawn point here).

text.name: NF_help_ueberblick_text1
text.text: With "Living Roads" your neighbours are on the move: AI tractors, some with an implement, drive on their own along the AI roads of the map, stop at your waypoints, park for a while and drive on. After a number of trips they call it a day and park; later they are woken up again.

text.name: NF_help_ueberblick_text2
text.text: Vehicles only appear while a player is in the game, about 3 minutes after joining. You set how many drive at the same time in the settings; fewer drive at night and at noon (daily rhythm). Destinations are your waypoints plus points along the AI roads that the mod finds itself (server config "zielQuelle" = "wegpunkte": your points only).

text.name: NF_help_wegpunkte_text1
text.text: Waypoints are managed in ESC > Settings > tab "Waypoints" (admin only): "Set waypoint here" and "Set spawn point here" create a point at your position. There you can browse the points, change their type, delete them and teleport to them.

text.name: NF_help_wegpunkte_text2
text.text: Types: Normal (20–60 s stop), Short (5–20 s), Long (2–5 min) and spawn point. New vehicles are loaded at spawn points. Best set them from a tractor on the right lane, front facing the driving direction, with some room ahead. Without a spawn point the mod looks for a free spot on an AI road itself.

text.name: NF_help_wegpunkte_text3
text.text: Under "Vehicle types" you choose which vehicles the neighbours use (small, medium, large tractors, wheel loaders, telehandlers). "Show WP on map" displays the points as map markers.

text.name: NF_help_einstellungen_text1
text.text: The settings are in ESC > Settings, section "Living Roads" (only admins can change them): mod on/off, number of traffic vehicles (1–8), implement size and "Narrow map" (small tractors with light implements only).

text.name: NF_help_einstellungen_text2
text.text: On a server there is also the file modSettings/FS25_NachbarFelder/NachbarFelderServerConfig.xml, e.g. for spawn intervals, parking times, pool size, implement share and "spielverkehrAnmelden". Changes there take effect after a restart.

text.name: NF_help_tasten_text1
text.text: Default keys (changeable in Settings > Controls, entries "Living Roads: …"): Ctrl + Alt + O set waypoint, Ctrl + Alt + U remove last waypoint, Ctrl + Alt + C show waypoints one by one, Ctrl + Alt + L remove all neighbour vehicles (admin only).

text.name: NF_help_tasten_text2
text.text: Console commands: nachbarFelderTrafficStop stops traffic and removes the vehicles, nachbarFelderTrafficStart allows it again, nachbarFelderEntfernen removes all vehicles, nachbarFelderTimer shows the time until the next spawn.

text.name: NF_help_verkehr_text1
text.text: The cars of the game traffic brake for the neighbour vehicles. If they still collide in narrow spots, switch off traffic in the game menu or set "spielverkehrAnmelden" to false in the server config.

text.name: NF_help_verkehr_text2
text.text: A vehicle that stays stuck picks a new destination and is removed if necessary. Loading spots where vehicles cannot get away are locked for that map. For problem reports the lines starting with "NachbarFelder:" from log.txt help most.
